name: Ahmed Jallouli
title: Ex IEEE IAS ENIS SBC Chairman
quote: As a past Chair of the IEEE IAS ENIS Student Branch Chapter, this experience marked a significant chapter of my journey. We led impactful initiatives, strengthened national collaborations, and promoted the link between academics and industry. It was a period of growth, responsibility, and continuous learning that shaped my leadership and vision.

name: Rahma Ben Jemaa
title: Ex IEEE IAS ENIS SBC Chairwoman
quote: As the chair of IEEE IAS ENIS SBC, my journey has been transformative. Through challenges and perseverance, my team and I earned recognition as the Best IEEE IAS Chapter globally, with numerous awards and impactful workshops. Leadership, for me, is about action, not authority. Success is earned through hard work, learning, and facing fears.

name: Katem Khedhiri
title: Ex IEEE IAS ENIS SBC Chairman
quote: Being a former Chair of the IEEE IAS ENIS Student Branch Chapter was one of the most meaningful experiences of my journey. It helped me grow personally and professionally, allowing me to develop both technical and interpersonal skills while facing new challenges with confidence. This experience strengthened my passion for IEEE volunteering.

name: Mezri Azaiez
title: Quality Assurance Engineer & Ex IEEE ENIS SB Chairman
quote: I was IEEE ENIS SB Chapter Chair. The IAS focuses specifically on the unique needs of industry and commerce. I adore volunteering; I learned a lot from such noble work. IEEE was an opportunity to develop my skills. I learned how to manage both team and time, and I carry those lessons with me to this day in my professional career.

name: Amir Abid
title: Ex IEEE IAS ENIS SBC Chairman
quote: During my time as IEEE IAS ENIS Chairman, the journey was truly remarkable. I learned invaluable lessons in teamwork, stress management, and the importance of familial bonds. We were more than just a board — we were a close-knit family, supporting each other through thick and thin. I'm grateful for every moment shared and proud of our achievements.

name: Jawhar Ben Salem
title: Software Engineer & Ex IEEE Committee Coordinator
quote: My IEEE experience was truly something to mark in my life. It was an incredibly rewarding journey that helped shape my career. I gained a wide range of skills — from leadership and communication to technical expertise — that continue to benefit me in my professional path. A unique and unforgettable experience that I would recommend to every student.

name: Amine Abid
title: Ex IEEE IAS ENIS SBC Chairman
quote: Being the IEEE IAS ENIS SBC Chairman wasn't only a great experience for me, it was way more than that. This chapter in my life enabled me to thrive in both my studies and personal growth. New skills, new strategies, new focus on matters connected to my field of study — all of these are just a drop of the sea of benefits and experiences that I gained.

name: Dhiaa Mejdi
title: Ex IEEE IAS ENIS SBC Chairman
quote: IEEE IAS ENIS Student Branch Chapter was a turning point in my journey, teaching me discipline, teamwork, and the true value of commitment. Working alongside an exceptional team helped shape my personality and strengthen my skills on many levels. More than a chapter, it was a real family, carrying forward our motto: Write your name in history.
